item.title: Vessel reports small craft approach near Bab-el-Mandeb
item.description: A bulk carrier transiting the Bab-el-Mandeb strait reported two small craft approaching before escorts responded.

item.title: Port authority extends inspection window
item.description: Inspections at a Gulf of Aden terminal were extended by six hours, according to an invented port circular.

item.title: Shipping advisory updated for the Strait of Hormuz
item.content:encoded: An advisory covering the Strait of Hormuz was reissued with no change to its guidance.
